The `gold-band/` Git submodule is an independent, read-only UI and interaction reference.

JI pins the official ACP SDKs for protocol conformance and checks in the v1 and isolated v2-preview JSON schemas extracted from the TypeScript SDK package.

- TypeScript SDK: `@agentclientprotocol/sdk` 1.4.0, <https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/typescript-sdk>

- License: Apache License 2.0

The checked-in schema bytes retain their upstream provenance and integrity hashes in `protocol/acp/integrity.json`.

## Protocol Buffers and Buf tooling

Stage 0 uses Protocol Buffers and Buf to define, generate and validate HCP models.

- Protocol Buffers Java/runtime and compiler: <https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf>, BSD 3-Clause License
- `protoc` npm wrapper 35.1.0: <https://github.com/timostamm/protobuf-npm>, Apache License 2.0
- Buf CLI 1.72.0 and Protobuf-ES 2.14.1: <https://github.com/bufbuild/buf> and <https://github.com/bufbuild/protobuf-es>, Apache License 2.0
